edge_policy.hard_edge_admission: exact cross-target Lean import plus content-bound receipt, or structured source theorem/path hashes consumed by a replay validator
edge_policy.reuse_hint_admission: named provider theorem/declaration/module with reviewable evidence but no checked target-local import/transport
edge_policy.unknown_policy: absence of an admitted edge is unknown_not_independent_proof_claim, never proof of independence
edge_policy.hard_dependency_worker_policy: before proof work, inspect every direct and transitive hard parent plus its reusable artifacts
edge_policy.reuse_hint_worker_policy: inspect hints opportunistically; hints never block claims, acceptance, or transfer checkbox state

hard_edges.state_semantics: blocks only on provider artifact availability/hash; never requires or inherits provider checkbox state
orders proof preparation; never transfers checkbox state or theorem-completion credit

reuse_hints.reuse_boundary: inspect the provider proof before rebuilding the compact-minimization bridge; an exact checked transport is still absent
Kingman declarations can discharge an analytic input only after a target-local adapter and composition check
Kingman is one analytic input and does not construct the Oseledets splitting
generic CLT is reusable, but weighted-row construction, limit transport, and target composition remain open
Cramer-Wold is reusable, but evaluation-vector laws and scalar projection limits remain open
